title: Passlib bcrypt 5.x 72-byte value error on authentication
root_cause: bcrypt 5.0.0 removed __about__.__version__ and enforced hard 72-byte limit during passlib wrap-bug detection.

title: MissingGreenlet exception during Pipeline stages serialization
root_cause: Pipeline.stages relationship was lazily loaded by default, causing MissingGreenlet when Pydantic serialized stages in async context.
fix_description: Added lazy='selectin' to Pipeline.stages in orm.py and selectinload(Pipeline.stages) in pipelines.py.

title: ResponseValidationError on AuditLog query due to primary key mismatch
root_cause: AuditLogResponse schema specified audit_log_id while ORM model defines log_id.
fix_description: Updated AuditLogResponse in crm-backend/app/routers/audit.py to use log_id.

title: Race condition on simultaneous lead creation causing UNIQUE constraint crash
root_cause: _seed_lookups was executed concurrently across simultaneous requests without mutual exclusion locking.
fix_description: Added asyncio.Lock() protection to _seed_lookups in crm-backend/app/routers/leads.py.
